WiFi

or

records.body:
Control Center > EinkWise > Color Mode > Tap Custom
 
For monochrome E Ink models, the screen will display colors in grayscale. Suitable adjustments of contrast and color settings can increase the overall display effect of the images. The color display of each app can be set independently without affecting the system-wide display. In this article, you will learn how to adjust the contrast and color of the display based on your reading preference.
 
【Monochrome E Ink models】
 
【Color E Ink models】
 

Contrast

When the value is increased, it enhances the visual clarity of content, making texts appear crisper and graphic elements more distinct.
 

* Light Color Filter

When the value is increased, it will turn more light colors (highlights) to white. It is generally used to lighten the background color.
 
Note: This setting is only available for monochrome E Ink models.
 

* Vividness

When the value is increased, it will increase the saturation of the colors.
 
Note: This setting is only available for color E Ink models.
 

* Color Brightness

When the value is increased, it will increase the brightness of the colors.
 
Note: This setting is only available for color E Ink models.
 

Contrast Settings in NeoReader

You can also adjust Contrast Settings for each file in NeoReader. Please refer to the Contrast Adjustments page in the Reading chapter for more info.

records.body:
Since Firmware V3.3.2, we have introduced Work Profile, designed to help you keep your personal and work data separate. Similar to an app cloner, it allows you to duplicate installed apps on your device and log in with different accounts in the same app. With this feature, you can easily switch between your personal and work profiles, ensuring that your data remains organized and secure.
 
Note: This function is only available for select models.
 
To enable Work Profile, do the following:
  1. In Home Screen, go to Settings > Apps & Notifications > Work Profile.
  2. Toggle on Enable Work Profile.
  3. Follow the instructions in the new window.
  4. After completing the process, toggle on the app you would like to create a duplicate and wait for the installation.
  5. Then you will have a duplicated app with separate data on the Home Screen.

BOOX NeoBrowser is specially developed for BOOX devices. The Full-Screen Mode, font size adjustment and more tools enable an all-new instant browsing experience on E Ink displays. In this article, you will learn more about the features of NeoBrowser.
 
 

Font Size Adjustments

Here you can tap to adjust the font size by preset levels conveniently from the menu bar.
 

Full-Screen Mode

Full-Screen Mode offers a minimalistic view that eliminates almost all distractions while you read an article or try to work online.
 

Page Visibility Enhancement

Here you can enhance the visibility for web page display on E Ink devices.
 
To toggle on / off page visibility enhancement, do the following:
  1. In NeoBrowser, tap the kebab menu in the upper right corner.
  2. Choose "Page Visibility Enhanced".
 

Integrated Dictionary

In NeoBrowser, you can use the built-in dictionary app to quickly look up a word.
 
To use the built-in dictionary app, do the following:
  1. In NeoBrowser, long press a word to select it.
  2. Tap the Dictionary button.
  3. Then you can also switch to different dictionaries in the popup window.

records.body:
PushRead is a built-in app to receive RSS and OPDS subscriptions as well as receiving pushed webpages for you to read later on your BOOX device as a bookmark manager. In this article, you will learn more about the features of PushRead.
 
 

Push

Here you can keep the bookmarked webpages for you from the computer to read later on your BOOX device. Please refer to the Transfer with Your Computer and Transfer with Your Smartphone pages for more info.
 

RSS

RSS (Really Simple Syndication) is a web feed that allows users and apps to access updates to websites. Here you can add RSS subscriptions and receive updates from public and custom sources.
 
To add an RSS subscription from built-in public sources, do the following:
  1. Switch to the RSS tab in the PushRead app.
  2. Go to Directory > Add subscription.
  3. Choose a public source and tap Subscribe.
 
To add an RSS subscription from custom sources, do the following:
  1. Switch to the RSS tab in the PushRead app.
  2. Go to Directory > Add subscription > Custom.
  3. Tap Add Group and type in a group name.
  4. Tap the Add icon on the upper right corner.
  5. Input a source and tap OK.
 
To add an RSS subscription by importing an OPML file, do the following:
  1. Switch to the RSS tab in the PushRead app.
  2. Tap the hamburger icon on the upper right corner and choose Import from OPML.
  3. Select an OPML file from the storage.
 

OPDS

OPDS (Open Publication Distribution System) is an open standard meant to facilitate the distribution of publications. OPDS catalogs enable users to browse, search and acquire content in an easy to use and decentralized ecosystem. Here you can add OPDS catalogs and receive updates from custom sources.
 
To add an OPDS catalog from custom sources, do the following:
  1. Switch to the OPDS tab in the PushRead app.
  2. Go to Directory > Add subscription > Custom.
  3. Tap Add Group and type in a group name.
  4. Tap the Add icon on the upper right corner.
  5. Input a source and tap OK.

Expand your storage and get access to your various files through binding third-party cloud storage apps. We support Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive, Baidu Cloud, NutStore, and other cloud storage that utilize the WebDAV protocol, such as NextCloud.
 

Bind Third-Party Cloud Storage App

Home Screen＞Library＞Cloud icon. Choose the app you prefer and log in. You can bind more than one account in the same or different cloud storage app.
 
 

Download from Third-Party Cloud Storage to the Library.

After login, you can see all your folders and files. Tap the file you want and it will be downloaded to the Library where a bookshelf will be automatically created and named after your email address or account name.
 

Upload from the Library to Third-Party Cloud Storage

  • Go to Storage
  • Press and hold the document you want to upload
  • Tap "Copy to Cloud Storage"
  • Paste it into the folder you want
  • Tap the document to upload
 
Note: You can only copy documents like EPUB and PDF from storage to the cloud. For images and videos, you can share them through third-party apps.

In this article, you will learn how to use the BOOX Assistant app to transfer documents, screensavers, and webpages to your BOOX device from your smartphone.
 
 

Download BOOX Assistant and Setting

1. Download the app to your smartphone.
Android: Please click here to download and install on your Android device.
iOS: Please search for "BOOX Assistant" in the App Store to download and install on your iOS device.
2. Log into the same account on your phone and BOOX device.
3. Connect your phone and device with the same LAN (local area network).
4. Choose the same server as that on your BOOX Assistant app
 

Transfer with BOOXDrop (Recommended)

1. Send from a smartphone to a BOOX device.

On the home screen, tap BOOXDrop＞Send to BOOX, and choose the file you want to send. Check the sent file in the Receive tab of BOOXDrop on your device.

2. Download from a BOOX device to a smartphone
On the home screen, tap BOOXDrop, pick the file you want to download, and tap Save to Phone. You can choose a specific type of file from the top menu.

Transfer with Push

1. On the home screen, tap Push＞plus icon in the bottom left and upload the file.
2. Check the file on the Push tab of BOOXDrop on your device.
3. The transferred screensaver will be shown in the Gallery app

Other Features of the BOOX Assistant app

Scan

Here you can scan the QR code generated by some apps on your BOOX device to preview it quickly

Official Accessories

Here you can run an OTA update to our official accessories after pairing them..

PushRead

Here you can transfer webpages to your BOOX device from your smartphone, and receive updates from RSS and OPDS subscriptions on your ONYX account.

Notes

Here you can check your notes that have been synced to the cloud.

Library

Here you can check your progress, bookmarks, and annotations of the books synced to the cloud.

In this article, you will learn how to improve the display of text and images for better clarity and comfort in the Display tab.

Contrast: Adjust this setting to increase or decrease the contrast of your content.

Saturation: Adjust this setting to change the intensity of colors. Increasing saturation makes hues appear more vibrant, while decreasing it results in softer, more muted tones.

Color Brightness: Adjust this to brighten the colored layers of the display without affecting the black text. This is particularly useful for making illustrations or charts more legible without washing out the ink density.

Image Sharpening: Adjust this setting to enhance or soften the sharpness of images and text.

De-Watermark: Use this adjustment to fade or remove light-colored watermarks from your documents.

Image Smoothing: Enable this to improve the smoothness of image gradients and reduce mottling. This option is only available in Regal Mode.

AI Assistant was incorporated into NeoReader to help with your reading. The assistant provides instant context and references to help you understand the content. You can choose an AI Model and a preset Word Count by tapping the hamburger icon. The daily word generation limit is 100,000 characters if you log in, and 3,000 if you do not.

You can ask questions by:

Selecting vector images: In reflowable documents like EPUB, you can long-press vector images within the document to ask questions about them.

Circling specific areas with your stylus: While taking handwritten notes within NeoReader, you can use your stylus to circle any part of the content to ask questions.

Highlighting text: When you highlight text, you can directly ask questions on the selected passage.

We provide Keyboard Covers, with and without a trackpad, to offer extra protection and PC-like efficiency. In this article, you will learn how to use it.

The Keyboard Cover is designed with pogo pins for connection. Simply attach your device to the pogo pins, and it will automatically change its orientation to landscape mode.

Navigate with Keyboard

Besides using the touchscreen, you can also navigate your device with the arrow keys on the keyboard.

We designed a range of shortcuts for our ePaper devices, which allows for easy access to popular functions. Click here to view a complete list of shortcuts.

For the keyboard cover with a trackpad, you can control the cursor with your fingers. In addition, you can define gestures according to your habits to increase efficiency. Please do as follows:
Setting＞More Settings＞Physical Keyboard＞Trackpad Gesture＞Custom
 
Note: Currently, only Tab Ultra C Pro supports customizing Trackpad Gestures.
 

Advanced Settings

For more advanced settings, go to Settings > System Settings > Physical keyboard.

records.body:
Talk Insights is an intelligent feature within the Notes app that enables users to record, transcribe, and summarize content while talking. During a talk, it can automatically convert spoken content into text in real-time and generate a concise meeting summary afterward.

Availability

Talk Insights is currently available in specific countries and regions. Only certain languages are supported for speech recognition and transcription. We will gradually expand the supported regions and languages based on actual circumstances. Before enabling this feature, please ensure that your country or region is listed below.

How to Enable

Step 1. Turn on Wi-Fi or mobile data.

Step 2. Open Settings > Lab Features > Explore Lab Features

Step 3. Choose Talk Insights.

Step 4. Enable the feature. Carefully read any pop-up notices.

Step 5. Tap "I understand and agree" to accept the terms and privacy information.

Step 6. You can now tap New Talk to start using Talk Insights immediately, or open the Notes app and tap Create to create a new Talk Insights note.

Troubleshooting

1. Feature not visible

Confirm your app is up to date and your device region/language matches the supported list.

2. Low-quality transcription

Move to a quieter area, or position the device closer to the speaker(s).

3. Missing notes after disabling

Check your backup (cloud or local export). If you did not back up before disabling, notes removed from the device may be unrecoverable.
